title: Logics-STEM: Empowering LLM Reasoning via Failure-Driven Post-Training and Document Knowledge Enhancement
authors_zh: Mingyu Xu, Cheng Fang, Keyue Jiang, Yuqian Zheng, Yanghua Xiao, Baojian Zhou, Qifang Zhao, Suhang Zheng, Xiuwen Zhu, Jiyang Tang, Yongchi Zhao, Yijia Luo, Zhiqi Bai, Yuchi Xu, Wenbo Su, Wei Wang, Bing Zhao, Lin Qu, Xiaoxiao Xu
paper_type_zh: STEM 长 CoT 数据集与失败驱动后训练报告
best_for_zh: 适合整理大规模 STEM 推理数据混合或针对模型失败设计第二阶段训练的研究者。
one_line: Logics-STEM curates millions of long-CoT STEM records and uses model failures to retrieve documents and synthesize targeted data for a second SFT or RLVR stage.
Logics-STEM 整理数百万条 STEM 长 CoT 记录，并围绕模型失败点检索文档、合成针对性数据，用于第二阶段 SFT 或 RLVR。
why: It links large-scale data curation, explicit decontamination, sampling, and failure-targeted post-training in one disclosed pipeline.
inclusion_reason: Provides a large long-CoT corpus and a failure-driven recipe that turns model errors plus retrieved documents into targeted second-stage data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Large STEM reasoning mixtures often contain invalid questions, duplicates, benchmark leakage, repetitive teacher responses, and too many short/easy examples. Even after broad SFT, a model's remaining failures are sparse and poorly represented by the original training distribution.

Logics-STEM first curates and distills millions of long-CoT STEM records, then uses the SFT model's verified failures to retrieve relevant documents and synthesize targeted second-stage SFT or RLVR data. It contributes both an open corpus and a data-to-training loop that concentrates updates on observed failure regions.

L4 facts: official source arXiv:2601.01562v3, dated 20 January 2026; arXiv preprint with no confirmed venue; decision boundary is curated long-CoT supervision plus failure-targeted synthetic records; Track-01 object is a STEM question, metadata, reasoning response, and final answer; collected as an existing promoted Card.

大规模 STEM 推理混合数据常含无效问题、重复样本、benchmark 泄漏、重复的教师回答，并且短题和简单题过多。即使完成广泛 SFT，模型剩余失败仍很稀疏，难以由原训练分布充分覆盖。

Logics-STEM 先整理并蒸馏数百万条长 CoT STEM 记录，再根据 SFT 模型经过验证的失败检索相关文档，合成有针对性的二阶段 SFT 或 RLVR 数据。它同时提供开放语料和数据到训练闭环，使更新集中在已观察到的失败区域。

L4 事实：官方来源为 arXiv:2601.01562v3，日期为 2026-01-20；目前仅确认 arXiv 预印本，未确认正式会议；判定边界是整理后的长 CoT 监督和面向失败区域的合成记录；Track 01 对象是 STEM 问题、元数据、推理回答与最终答案组成的记录；该条目是已有并已提升的 Card。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Logics-STEM couples two data decisions: build a broad, decontaminated long-CoT base distribution, then reshape the second-stage prompt distribution toward questions the current model fails. Retrieved documents supply knowledge for new failure-adjacent questions, while verified final answers support either continued SFT or RLVR. The reusable contribution is this explicit curation and feedback contract, not only the released model scores.

Google Scholar citations: 0（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Logics-STEM%3A+Empowering+LLM+Reasoning+via+Failure-Driven+Post-Training+and+Document+Knowledge+Enhancement&author=Mingyu+Xu&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Names: Logics-STEM-SFT-Dataset-Open-5.3M and its downsampled 1.6M version. Official URLs: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Logics-MLLM/Logics-STEM-SFT-Dataset-Open-5.3M and https://huggingface.co/Logics-MLLM. Scale: 7.2M curated records before stratified sampling and 2.2M records used for the reported SFT; the public 5.3M/1.6M releases exclude private data. Record form: source question/provenance, domain and difficulty annotations, long-CoT response, final/verifiable answer, and sampling metadata; exact storage fields should be checked on the dataset card. Construction uses Qwen3-235B annotation/distillation, deduplication, 13-gram decontamination, and length-stratified sampling. License: CC BY-NC 4.0. Intended use: STEM long-CoT SFT and failure-driven post-training.

Logics-STEM 结合两个数据决策：先构建覆盖广、去污染的长 CoT 基础分布，再让二阶段 prompt 分布偏向当前模型答错的问题。检索文档为失败邻域的新问题提供知识，经过验证的最终答案则支持继续 SFT 或 RLVR。可复用贡献是明确的数据整理与反馈契约，而不只是发布模型的分数。

开源数据：有。名称：Logics-STEM-SFT-Dataset-Open-5.3M 及其下采样 1.6M 版本。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Logics-MLLM/Logics-STEM-SFT-Dataset-Open-5.3M 和 https://huggingface.co/Logics-MLLM。规模：分层采样前有 7.2M 条整理记录，论文训练使用 2.2M 条；公开 5.3M 和 1.6M 版本排除了私有数据。记录形式：来源问题与溯源、领域和难度标注、长 CoT 回答、最终或可验证答案及采样元数据；具体存储字段应以数据集卡为准。构造使用 Qwen3-235B 标注与蒸馏、去重、13-gram 去污染和按长度分层采样。许可：CC BY-NC 4.0。预期用途：STEM 长 CoT SFT 与 failure-driven 后训练。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Aggregate and annotate. Input: 15.25M public STEM questions plus educational documents. Operation: normalize records and use Qwen3-235B-Instruct to label validity, domain, level, answer type, and other quality fields. Output: structured candidate questions. Check: remove invalid, ambiguous, and unsupported records.
  2. Deduplicate and decontaminate. Input: annotated candidates and target evaluations. Operation: apply MD5 exact matching, MinHash near-duplicate filtering, and remove identical 13-gram overlap with benchmark samples. Output: cleaner source questions. Check: retain provenance and log each removal criterion.
  3. Distill long reasoning. Input: retained questions. Operation: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking writes long-CoT responses; repetitive outputs are filtered and incorrect answers may be regenerated once. Output: 7.2M curated records. Check: verify final answers where possible, noting that incorrect teacher responses are not categorically removed.
  4. Sample the SFT mixture. Input: curated records ranked by response length. Operation: keep all above the 75th percentile, 50% of the 50th-75th band, and 10% of the 20th-50th band. Output: 2.2M records, including 1.05M math and 1.14M broader-STEM examples. Check: audit domain/source balance, not only length.
  5. Target model failures. Input: the first-stage SFT model and a target question distribution. Operation: identify verified wrong answers, retrieve related documents, and synthesize new questions and solutions around those failure regions. Output: failure-driven data mixed with original SFT records. Check: verify answers and prevent target benchmark text from becoming training leakage.
  6. Run second-stage training. Input: the failure-driven mixture. Operation: perform continued SFT or sample its prompts for RLVR with verified reward. Output: Logics-STEM SFT/RL models. Check: compare source-specific synthetic mixtures, mixture ratios, and original-data baselines.

Reproducibility: paper, 5.3M/1.6M datasets, and model pages are official. Exact reproduction is limited because the released corpus excludes private data; pin source snapshots, teachers, dedup/decontamination thresholds, sampling strata, retrieval index, and RL reward settings.

1. 汇总并标注。 输入：15.25M 道公开 STEM 问题和教育文档。操作：规范化记录，用 Qwen3-235B-Instruct 标注有效性、领域、级别、答案类型及其它质量字段。输出：结构化候选问题。检查：删除无效、有歧义或缺少支持的记录。
  2. 去重并去污染。 输入：已标注候选和目标评测集。操作：使用 MD5 精确匹配、MinHash 近重复过滤，并删除与 benchmark 样本存在相同 13-gram 的记录。输出：更干净的来源问题。检查：保留溯源，并记录每种删除标准。
  3. 蒸馏长推理。 输入：保留问题。操作：Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking 生成长 CoT 回答，过滤重复输出，错误答案可重新生成一次。输出：7.2M 条整理记录。检查：尽可能验证最终答案，同时注意错误教师回答并非一律删除。
  4. 采样 SFT 混合。 输入：按回答长度排序的整理记录。操作：保留第 75 百分位以上全部样本，从第 50 至 75 百分位保留 50%，从第 20 至 50 百分位保留 10%。输出：2.2M 条记录，其中数学 1.05M 条，更广泛 STEM 1.14M 条。检查：除长度外还要审计领域与来源平衡。
  5. 针对模型失败。 输入：一阶段 SFT 模型和目标问题分布。操作：识别答案经验证为错误的样本，检索相关文档，并围绕这些失败区域合成新问题与解答。输出：与原 SFT 记录混合的 failure-driven 数据。检查：验证答案，并防止目标 benchmark 原文变成训练泄漏。
  6. 执行二阶段训练。 输入：failure-driven 混合数据。操作：继续 SFT，或从其中采样 prompt，以可验证奖励执行 RLVR。输出：Logics-STEM SFT 与 RL 模型。检查：比较不同来源的合成混合、混合比例和只用原数据的 baseline。

复现信息：论文、5.3M 与 1.6M 数据集及模型页均为官方来源。由于公开语料排除了私有数据，无法完全复现；需要固定来源快照、教师模型、去重与去污染阈值、采样分层、检索索引和 RL 奖励设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
End-to-end 8B claim. Under the paper's 64K-context evaluation, Logics-STEM-8B-RL scores 90.42 on AIME 2024, 87.08 on AIME 2025, 74.79 on HMMT 2025, 62.50 on BeyondAIME, and 73.93 on GPQA-Diamond; the paper reports a 4.68-point average lead over the next-best 8B model. This supports the complete data-plus-training stack, but does not isolate corpus curation from RLVR.

Failure-data source claim (Table 6). Starting from the same baseline, GRPO with science-derived failure data raises HMMT 2025 from 68.96 to 74.79 and GPQA-Diamond from 73.20 to 73.93; math-derived failure data reaches 70.42 and 72.70. Training algorithm and baseline are matched, showing that retrieved source choice materially changes transfer rather than all failure-adjacent data being interchangeable.

8B 端到端主张。 在论文的 64K context 评测下，Logics-STEM-8B-RL 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025、BeyondAIME 与 GPQA-Diamond 上分别得到 90.42、87.08、74.79、62.50 和 73.93；论文报告其平均领先下一个最佳 8B 模型 4.68 分。该结果支持完整的数据与训练组合，但没有隔离语料整理和 RLVR 的贡献。

失败数据来源主张，表 6。 从同一 baseline 出发，使用科学来源 failure-driven 数据的 GRPO 把 HMMT 2025 从 68.96 提高到 74.79，把 GPQA-Diamond 从 73.20 提高到 73.93；数学来源数据分别达到 70.42 和 72.70。训练算法与起点一致，说明检索来源会显著改变迁移效果，并非所有失败邻域数据都可互换。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Large long-CoT distillation and failure mining each exist separately. Logics-STEM connects them as a distribution-design loop: curation builds a broad first-stage proposal distribution, then verified model failures define where document-grounded synthesis should concentrate. The release also exposes large open pre- and post-downsampling variants with explicit deduplication and decontamination stages. The novelty is this data-algorithm co-design, not SFT, RLVR, or retrieval alone.
大规模长 CoT 蒸馏和失败挖掘都已有先例。Logics-STEM 把两者连接成分布设计闭环：数据整理建立覆盖广的一阶段提议分布，再由经过验证的模型失败决定文档增强合成应集中在哪里。发布内容还提供去重和去污染流程明确的大规模开放版本及下采样版本。新意在于这种数据与算法协同设计，而不是单独的 SFT、RLVR 或检索。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The exact training mixture is not reproducible because public 5.3M/1.6M releases exclude a private portion, and source-level rights must still be checked under the CC BY-NC 4.0 aggregation.
  • Incorrect teacher answers may be regenerated once but are not always removed, so scale should not be read as uniformly verified step-level quality.
  • Failure-driven synthesis can overfit the chosen target distribution; the paper's 150K scaling experiment improves only some benchmarks and degrades others.

• 公开 5.3M 和 1.6M 版本排除了私有部分，因此无法复现精确训练混合；即使聚合许可为 CC BY-NC 4.0，仍要检查各来源权利。
  • 错误教师答案可以重生成一次，但并非总会删除，因此数据规模不能被理解为所有步骤都得到统一验证。
  • Failure-driven 合成可能过拟合所选目标分布；论文把规模提高到 150K 时，只改善部分 benchmark，并使其它 benchmark 下降。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the open corpus as a large STEM long-CoT starting point, but retain provenance and rerun decontamination against the exact evaluation suite.
  • Use failure-driven retrieval when a first-stage model and objective answer checker are available; synthesize around error regions rather than resampling easy source data.
  • Tune source mixture and scale on held-out domains, because more targeted synthetic data can reduce performance outside the selected failure distribution.

• 可把开放语料作为大规模 STEM 长 CoT 起点，但必须保留溯源，并针对实际评测集重新去污染。
  • 当已有一阶段模型和客观答案检查器时，可使用 failure-driven 检索，围绕错误区域合成，而不是重复采样简单来源数据。
  • 应在留出领域上调节来源混合与规模，因为更多定向合成数据可能降低所选失败分布之外的表现。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: combine million-scale STEM long-CoT curation with a second stage aimed at verified model failures.
  • Method handle: annotate, deduplicate, decontaminate, distill, stratify, train, retrieve around failures, then retrain.
  • Data/artifact handle: 5.3M and 1.6M public CC BY-NC 4.0 releases; the reported SFT uses a 2.2M mixture containing private lineage.
  • Evidence anchor: the 8B RL model leads the reported suite; science failure data raises HMMT 68.96 to 74.79 in a matched comparison.
  • Reuse decision: valuable for STEM post-training after source-rights, teacher-error, contamination, and target-overfitting audits.

• 一句话定位： 把百万级 STEM 长 CoT 整理与针对模型已验证失败的二阶段训练结合起来。
  • 方法抓手： 标注、去重、去污染、蒸馏、分层、训练、围绕失败检索，再次训练。
  • 数据与产物抓手： 公开 5.3M 和 1.6M 版本采用 CC BY-NC 4.0；论文使用的 2.2M 混合含私有来源链。
  • 证据锚点： 8B RL 模型领先论文评测集合；匹配对比中，科学失败数据把 HMMT 从 68.96 提高到 74.79。
  • 复用决定： 适合 STEM 后训练，但必须审计来源权利、教师错误、数据污染与目标过拟合。
